items.exampleEn: We wear white coats in the lab.
This phone can find your location using a satellite.
items.exampleZh: 這支手機可以用衛星找到你的位置。

items.exampleEn: Only three students get this scholarship every year.
items.exampleZh: 每年只有三位學生能拿到這筆獎學金。

items.exampleEn: Late assignments will lose five points.
The driving instructor was very patient.
items.exampleZh: 那位駕訓班教練非常有耐心。

items.exampleEn: Physics is the hardest subject for me.

items.exampleZh: 這份問卷有二十個問題。

items.exampleEn: With her teacher's guidance, she chose a good career.
items.exampleZh: 在老師的指導下，她選了一份好職業。

items.sentenceEn: The science lab is on the second floor.

items.audioEn: Please finish the questionnaire and give it to the front desk before you leave.
items.audioZh: 請填完問卷，離開前交給櫃台。

items.sentenceEn: The new instructor teaches yoga on Tuesdays.
items.sentenceZh: 新來的教練每週二教瑜伽。

items.sentenceEn: My brother is studying physics at university.

items.stemEn: I can't go out tonight; I have to finish my history ____.
items.stemZh: 我今晚不能出門，得把歷史作業寫完。

items.stemEn: A ____ moves around the Earth and sends back pictures.
items.stemZh: 衛星繞著地球轉，並把照片傳回來。

items.passageEn: Sara wants to become an engineer. Last year, she won a scholarship from a big company, and she received it at a ceremony. Now she studies physics at a university and spends many hours in the lab. Her instructor gives the class a difficult assignment every week. This term, her team is helping to build a small satellite. Sara also filled in a questionnaire about student life. She says the guidance of her teachers has been very important.
items.passageZh: Sara 想成為工程師。去年，她拿到一家大公司提供的獎學金，還在典禮上領獎。現在她在大學念物理，花很多時間待在實驗室。她的講師每週都給全班一份很難的作業。這學期，她的團隊正在幫忙建造一顆小衛星。Sara 也填了一份關於學生生活的問卷。她說老師們的指導一直都很重要。

questions.questionZh: Sara 的團隊這學期在做什麼？

items.promptZh: 我的物理作業還沒寫完。
referenceEn: I haven't finished my physics assignment yet.
My physics assignment isn't finished yet.
rubricZh: assignment 表示「作業」，可數名詞，例如 finish an assignment 等說法
時態配合內容（例如現在完成式 haven't finished 等）

items.instructionZh: 用 guidance 造一個句子，說說誰給過你指導或建議。
referenceEn: My parents gave me a lot of guidance when I was in high school.
I asked my teacher for guidance about my studies.
rubricZh: guidance 表示「指導、輔導」，是不可數名詞，例如 give guidance、ask for guidance 等說法
說的是自己的經驗（例如 I、my）
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式）
